proof_body:
by
  intro V _ G k ⟨C⟩
  classical
  have h : ∀ c ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin k)), (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => C v = c)).card ≤ G.indepNum := by
    intro c _
    refine SimpleGraph.IsIndepSet.card_le_indepNum ?_
    intro a ha b hb _ hab
    simp at ha hb
    exact C.valid hab (ha.trans hb.symm)
  calc Fintype.card V = ∑ c : Fin k, (Finset.univ.filter (fun v => C v = c)).card := by
        rw [← Finset.card_univ]
        exact Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _)
    _ ≤ ∑ _c : Fin k, G.indepNum := Finset.sum_le_sum h
    _ = _ := by simp
target_source: ∀ (V : Type*) [Fintype V] (G : SimpleGraph V) (k : ℕ), G.Colorable k → Fintype.card V ≤ k * G.indepNum
